Here's a description of the provided plot, following the guidelines:

The plot illustrates the relationship between model size and average performance metrics. The x-axis is labeled “Model Size” and has a linear scale ranging from 70m to 7.0B, with tick labels at 70m, 160m, 410m, 1.0B, 1.4B, 2.8B, and 7.0B. The y-axis is labeled “Avg. Performance (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick labels at 0, 20, 40, 60, and 80. A red line, marked with triangle-shaped data points, represents “Precision” and begins at approximately 73% at 70m, declines to approximately 69% at 410m, and then increases to approximately 75% at 7.0B. A blue line, marked with triangle-shaped data points, represents “Recall” and begins at approximately 14% at 70m, increases to approximately 27% at 7.0B. A magenta line, marked with triangle-shaped data points, represents “F1-score” and begins at approximately 33% at 70m, increases to approximately 48% at 7.0B.
